name: mediaforge
description: Fully typed TypeScript wrapper for FFmpeg — fluent API, v6/v7/v8 compatible, zero native bindings
author: Qasim Ali

scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --exclude='dist/**' --report-dir=. --reporter=lcov --reporter=text node --import tsx/esm --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec $(find tests/unit tests/integration -name '*.test.ts' | tr '\n' ' ')
scripts.battle:all: npm run battle && npm run battle:new && npm run battle:cli && npm run battle:cov && npm run battle:gaps && npm run battle:lib && npm run battle:gaps2 && npm run battle:gaps3
scripts.battle:runtimes: npm run battle:runtime && deno task battle:runtime && bun run runtime-tests/battle.ts
scripts.check:types: npm run type-coverage && npm run check:dead && npm run check:scripts
scripts.coverage:battle: c8 --exclude='dist/**' --exclude='tests/**' --exclude='deno-tests/**' --exclude='*.test.ts' --report-dir=.battle --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --check-coverage=false --clean tsx tests/integration/battle.test.ts && c8 --exclude='dist/**' --exclude='tests/**' --exclude='deno-tests/**' --exclude='*.test.ts' --report-dir=.battle --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --check-coverage=false --clean=false tsx tests/integration/newfeatures.test.ts && c8 --exclude='dist/**' --exclude='tests/**' --exclude='deno-tests/**' --exclude='*.test.ts' --report-dir=.battle --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --check-coverage=false --clean=false tsx tests/integration/cli.test.ts && c8 --exclude='dist/**' --exclude='tests/**' --exclude='deno-tests/**' --exclude='*.test.ts' --report-dir=.battle --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --check-coverage=false --clean=false tsx tests/integration/coverage.test.ts && c8 --exclude='dist/**' --exclude='tests/**' --exclude='deno-tests/**' --exclude='*.test.ts' --report-dir=.battle --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --check-coverage=false --clean=false tsx tests/integration/gaps.test.ts && c8 --exclude='dist/**' --exclude='tests/**' --exclude='deno-tests/**' --exclude='*.test.ts' --report-dir=.battle --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --check-coverage=false --clean=false tsx tests/integration/libgaps.test.ts && c8 --exclude='dist/**' --exclude='tests/**' --exclude='deno-tests/**' --exclude='*.test.ts' --report-dir=.battle --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --check-coverage=false --clean=false tsx tests/integration/gaps2.test.ts && c8 --exclude='dist/**' --exclude='tests/**' --exclude='deno-tests/**' --exclude='*.test.ts' --report-dir=.battle --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --check-coverage=false --clean=false tsx tests/integration/gaps3.test.ts
scripts.coverage: c8 --exclude='dist/**' --report-dir=. --reporter=lcov --reporter=text node --import tsx/esm --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec $(find tests/unit tests/integration -name '*.test.ts' | tr '\n' ' ')
scripts.coverage:summary: c8 --exclude='dist/**' --report-dir=. --reporter=text-summary node --import tsx/esm --test --test-concurrency=1 $(find tests/unit tests/integration -name '*.test.ts' | tr '\n' ' ')
